answer: Require every epoch claim to carry a fresh, content-addressed work artifact, and run similarity hashing across all of them: near-duplicates collapse into one reward. A lone agent tending its own terrace grows something distinct each epoch, its trellis trained on its own past work. A farm stamping a thousand copies from one island of templates finds every clone hashed to the same fingerprint, so a thousand fakes pay out like one - copying becomes the tax, and originality the only currency that survives.
